organization.title: Who is applying?
organization.description: e.g. 'a small literary press', 'a community theater in Tacoma'.

tools.name: grants_status
tools.description: The whole pipeline: every open opportunity by deadline, soonest first (missed ones included), each with its funder, fit, ask, stage and the requirements still to do (with ids); what is submitted and awaiting a decision; and the outcomes so far. Call it first when asked what's due or where things stand.

tools.name: add_opportunity
tools.description: Save a funding opportunity or request for proposals: its title, funder, kind, deadline (YYYY-MM-DD), the ask in dollars, and how well it fits. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as one is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: update_opportunity
tools.description: Change an opportunity already on the list. When the funder moves the deadline by some days or weeks ('extended by two weeks'), pass extendDays (14) and the desk moves it; pass deadline only when they give the new date. Never work the date out yourself. Call it the moment they tell you, before you reply.

extendDays.description: How many days later the deadline moved, e.g. 14 for two weeks.

deadline.description: A new deadline, YYYY-MM-DD, only when they give the date.

ask.description: A new amount requested, in dollars.

tools.name: set_stage
tools.description: Move an opportunity to prospect, drafting, submitted (the moment it is sent, with any confirmation number as the note) or passed (decided not to apply). Call it as soon as the person says it moved.

note.description: Any confirmation number, exactly as given.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Record the funder's decision the moment it comes in: awarded (with the amount in dollars), declined, or passed. Put reporting dates or feedback in the note.

note.description: Reporting dates, feedback or conditions, in their words.

tools.name: add_requirement
tools.description: Add what a submission needs to its checklist (a budget narrative, work samples, a board list, letters of support): one as title, or several as titles. Existing items are kept, never duplicated. Call it as soon as the guidelines are read or the person lists them.

title.description: One thing the submission needs, e.g. 'Budget narrative'.

tools.name: check_requirement
tools.description: Check a requirement off the moment the person says it is ready (done: false reopens it).

tools.name: page_add_requirement
tools.description: Add a requirement to a submission.

title.description: One thing the submission needs, e.g. 'Budget narrative'.

tools.name: page_check_requirement
tools.description: Check a requirement off, or reopen it.

tools.name: page_set_stage
tools.description: Move an opportunity to another stage.

note.description: Any confirmation number, exactly as given.
Reporting dates, feedback or conditions, in their words.
